summary: Implements the audio dynacast manager, tracking subscribed audio codec enablement by MIME type and notifying publishers when codec subscription state changes.
responsibilities: Construct audio dynacast managers with shared base behavior.
Track subscribed and committed audio codec enablement per MIME type.
Forward local and remote-node audio subscription changes to per-codec dynacast quality trackers.
Commit changed audio codec subscription state and notify listeners asynchronously.

summary: Creates an audio dynacast manager with shared base behavior and per-codec audio quality trackers.
summary_step: 1. Fills a default logger when none is supplied.
2. Initializes audio manager state maps for desired and committed subscribed codecs.
3. Creates the shared dynacast manager base with audio-specific restart, quality creation, codec regression, and update callbacks.
4. Resets committed codec state on restart.
5. Creates dynacastQualityAudio instances for MIME types and updates subscription maps during codec regression.
6. Returns the audio manager as a DynacastManager.

summary: Forces all committed audio codecs to the supplied enabled state and enqueues a listener update.

summary: Notifies the per-codec audio quality tracker that one subscriber enabled or disabled an audio codec.
Notifies per-codec audio quality trackers about codec enablement reported by a downstream node.
Updates desired audio codec enablement for a MIME type and triggers manager update processing.
Commits changed audio subscribed codec state and enqueues listener notification when needed.
summary_step: 1. Locks manager state and logs desired and committed codec state.
2. Returns when no codec has been added yet.
3. Detects changes from map size differences or per-MIME enabled-state differences.
4. Returns when no change exists and force is false.
5. Replaces committed state with a copy of current desired state.
6. Enqueues subscribed codec change notification before unlocking.

summary: Builds subscribed audio codec protos from committed state and enqueues the listener callback.
summary_step: 1. Returns when the manager is closed or has no listener.
2. Converts committed subscribed codec state into LiveKit SubscribedAudioCodec protos.
3. Logs the outgoing subscribed codec list.
4. Enqueues OnDynacastSubscribedAudioCodecChange on the notification operation queue.
